# Shape of a real Debian 12 VPS ruleset (iptables v1.8.9, nf_tables backend),
# with addresses replaced by documentation ranges. Duplicated rules and the
# literal "$1" interface are as found: a WireGuard PostUp script re-run
# without cleanup.
*raw
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [99878506:54485030188]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [63579755:52854568203]
COMMIT
*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [43801281:11391521848]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [63579755:52854568203]
:f2b-caddy-app - [0:0]
:f2b-sshd - [0:0]
-A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 22 -j f2b-sshd
-A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -j f2b-caddy-app
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8000 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -i $1 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -o $1 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 10.99.0.2/32 -i ens6 -o $1 -p tcp -m tcp ! --dport 22 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 10.99.0.2/32 -i ens6 -o $1 -p udp -m udp ! --dport 51820 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -i $1 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -o $1 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 10.99.0.2/32 -i ens6 -o wg0 -p tcp -m multiport ! --dports 22,80,443,8001 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 10.99.0.2/32 -i ens6 -o wg0 -p udp -m udp ! --dport 51820 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -i wg0 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -o wg0 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 10.99.0.2/32 -i ens6 -o wg0 -p tcp -m multiport ! --dports 22,80,443,8001,2083 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A f2b-caddy-app -s 203.0.113.116/32 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
-A f2b-caddy-app -s 198.51.100.128/32 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
-A f2b-caddy-app -j RETURN
-A f2b-sshd -s 203.0.113.157/32 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
-A f2b-sshd -j RETURN
COMMIT
*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [2452091:276623612]
:INPUT ACCEPT [630806:83934961]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [525752:37363067]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [603029:36236402]
-A PREROUTING -i ens6 -p tcp -m multiport ! --dports 22,80,443,8001,2083 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.99.0.2
-A PREROUTING -i ens6 -p udp -m udp ! --dport 51820 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.99.0.2
-A PREROUTING -i ens6 -p udp -m udp ! --dport 51820 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.99.0.2
-A PREROUTING -i ens6 -p tcp -m multiport ! --dports 22,80,443,8001,2083 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.99.0.2
-A POSTROUTING -s 10.99.0.0/24 -o ens6 -m comment --comment wireguard-nat-rule -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -o ens6 -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -o ens6 -j MASQUERADE
COMMIT
